To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed iterative decoding approach to JSCC using combined TCQ and CPM is both power- and band-width-efficient compared with the combined TCM system and is also more bandwidth efficient compared with the combined CPM system.
the iterative decoding approach to JSCC using TCQ/CPMs is both power- and spectrum-efficient, and that it is faster than the bit-level iterative approach.
the combined TC/CPM with soft decoder and iterative decoder working at the symbol level outperforms the combined TC/TCM with hard decoder.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an efficient JSCC system for the transmission of speech and music signals over a Gaussian channel.
the design of a new JSCC system using a combined TCQ and CPM, and with the use of a novel soft-decision decoder and an iterative decoder for TCQ-based systems.
the development of a soft decoder for TCQ-based systems and an iterative decoding procedure for joint source and channel encoding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the combined TC/QCPM systems with symbol-level decoding have a better performance than the systems with bit-level decoding, and the combined TCQCPM with iterative symbol-level decoding has the best performance
the combined TCQM/CPM with soft decoding and iterative decoding outperforms all other JSCC systems in terms of SDR and complexity

the iterative decoding algorithm proposed in this paper is a powerful technique that improves the performance of the TCQ-based JCSOC systems, and the performance improvement is more pronounced at higher source encoding rates.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combined TC/CPM system with iterative decoding is a good alternative to the combined TCQ/treillis-codded modulation system for joint source-channel coding applications
the iterative decoding approach to JSCC using TCQ/CPMs is a promising approach to achieve high bandwidth and power efficiency.
, in terms of SDR, the proposed combined TCQ/ CPM with iterative decoding is superior to the combined TCQ /TCM with iterative decoding.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed iterative decoding algorithm can improve the performance of TCQ-based JSSC systems.
the combined TC/CPM with soft decoding and iterative decoding is more efficient than the combined TCQ/TM with hard decoding.
the combined TC/CPM with an iterative decoding algorithm is a good candidate for JSCC systems
